question.en: What happened to the boys in the night?
question.zh: 夜里孩子们出了什么事？

sentences.en: What happened to the boys in the night?
sentences.zh: 夜里孩子们出了什么事？

sentences.en: Late in the afternoon, the boys put up their tent in the middle of a field.
sentences.zh: 傍晚时分，孩子们在田野中央搭起了帐篷。

sentences.en: As soon as this was done, they cooked a meal over an open fire.
sentences.zh: 这件事刚刚做完，他们就在篝火上烧起了饭。

sentences.en: They were all hungry and the food smelled good.
sentences.zh: 他们全都饿了，饭菜散发出阵阵香味。

sentences.en: After a wonderful meal, they told stories and sang songs by the campfire.
sentences.zh: 一顿美餐之后，他们就围着篝火讲故事、唱歌。

sentences.en: But some time later it began to rain.
sentences.zh: 但过了一会儿下起雨来。

sentences.en: The boys felt tired so they put out the fire and crept into their tent.
sentences.zh: 孩子们感到累了，于是扑灭篝火，钻进了帐篷。

sentences.en: Their sleeping bags were warm and comfortable, so they all slept soundly.
sentences.zh: 睡袋又暖和又舒服，所以他们都睡得很香。

sentences.en: In the middle of the night, two boys woke up and began shouting.
sentences.zh: 半夜里两个孩子醒了，大叫起来。

sentences.en: The tent was full of water!
They all leapt out of their sleeping bags and hurried outside.
sentences.zh: 他们全都跳出睡袋，跑到外面。

sentences.en: It was raining heavily and they found that a stream had formed in the field.
sentences.zh: 雨下得很大，他们发现田野里已经形成了一条小溪。

sentences.en: The stream wound its way across the field and then flowed right under their tent!
sentences.zh: 小溪弯弯曲曲地穿过田野，正好从他们的帐篷底下流过！
